name: semester-navigator
description: Guided school connections and saved semester plans, with cloud continuity under acceptance testing.

interface.shortDescription: Connect your school and see what needs your attention.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT guides school connections, checks class coverage, and supports planning, rubric review and research. Separate student profiles preserve their own semester context. Cloud continuity adds a shared saved plan for phone and desktop when the authenticated cloud connection is available; the repository install alone does not connect the cloud plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Semester Navigator to set up my semester. Ask me questions one at a time and help me connect my school accounts.
